subject: Backend Engineer at Azodha - 7 yrs of Node.js, TypeScript & AWS Expertise
body:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to express my interest in the Backend Engineer position at Azodha. With over 7 years of experience in backend development, particularly in Node.js and TypeScript, I am eager to contribute to your innovative team.

Currently, as an AI Full Stack Senior Developer at Impressico Business Solutions, I have successfully designed and scaled backend services and APIs. My focus on performance optimization led to a 90% reduction in CI/CD deployment failures and a significant improvement in production stability. I possess deep expertise in PostgreSQL and have utilized AWS tools such as AWS Glue, ensuring the maintenance of reliable data pipelines that are crucial for effective data warehousing solutions.

Moreover, I have a proven track record of managing AWS infrastructure, including ECS, EC2, and RDS, while developing secure systems that comply with data protection standards. My collaborative work with cross-functional teams, including product and QA stakeholders, has further enhanced project outcomes and streamlined deployment processes.

I am particularly impressed by Azodha's commitment to advancing backend technologies while emphasizing data security, especially in handling protected health information. I am enthusiastic about leveraging my skills in event-driven architectures and automated testing frameworks to optimize your development lifecycle.

Attached are my resume and fitment report for your review. I would appreciate the opportunity to discuss how my experience aligns with the needs of your team. Please feel free to contact me at your convenience.

Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,

Virender Kumar
